description: This file serves as core request processing logic for a sophisticated proxy server for language model APIs, particularly those compatible with OpenAI’s API structure. It includes functions and classes for streaming responses, error handling, header management, request validation, and response injection, tailored to handle both streaming and non-streaming API requests with advanced logging, cost tracking, and custom header construction.
